label: D2 after a2 led rarely to S1, following an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only on rare transitions of one kind: the agent chose a2 and reached S1 (in_action=2, in_state=1, in_rew=0). Every activation falls inside (D2, a2, S1R), but that superset alone has precision 0.21. Adding prev_reward == 0 (the previous trial went unrewarded) keeps 91% of the activation mass and raises dev F1 to 0.61. The strongest activations come in streaks of repeated a2 -> S1 rare unrewarded trials, while S2 is good and the policy strongly prefers a2. Weak activations (about 9% of mass) come on a2 -> S1R after a rewarded trial. Adding prev_action == 2, choice < -4.44 or value < 7.54 changes F1 by at most 0.05 and costs mass recall, so I kept the simpler predicate. Never fires at D1/GO, after a1, on S2, or on common transitions. Many in-pattern steps stay below threshold; whether it fires seems to depend on longer reward history, which I could not capture. All variables are observed at D2.
